# WO-217: Keep developer-doc file:line citations resolvable
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-049)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: test-quality
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Source: CP-48 (docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md), accepted with one addition

## Goal / acceptance criteria
As written in CP-48: parse explicit `path:line` and `path:line-range` references and assert each file exists and every cited line is in bounds, with fake temporary cases for malformed and out-of-range references. Report by document and citation. Do not rewrite docs; validity is not proof the prose is accurate.

Addition: cover `docs/i18n/STRINGS.md` and `docs/i18n/GLOSSARY_ES.md` as well as `docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/dev/TESTING.md` (WO-214 added 59 citations there). Keep the existing broker-guide citation test as is.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_source_citations.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_dev_source_citations.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex`
